stem.text: Three coplanar forces act on an object in the directions shown.
In which diagram could the object be in equilibrium?

A.alt: Grey irregular object with three arrows drawn as lines with arrowheads pointing toward or away from it at its upper left, upper right and lower area.

B.alt: Grey irregular object with three arrows drawn as lines with arrowheads at its upper left, lower left and upper right.

C.alt: Grey irregular object with three arrows drawn as lines with arrowheads at its top, lower right and lower left.

D.alt: Grey irregular object with three arrows drawn as lines with arrowheads at its left, right and lower left.
